audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[0..6] reads Gangplank/Skill/Sion/Sion/Gangplank/Sion/Sion and the full phases repeat it, but the packet chart is Sion/Sion/Sion/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank/Sion and the prose agrees with the packet, not the chart: whys[0] says 'I concede early', whys[2] says 'his early control owns levels 1-3', whys[3] says mid-lane is 'roughly even', whys[5] calls the Sheen item 'my clearest kill threat'. The lane also sits at 47.84% over 1643 games while the page calls it EVEN at 6/10.
audit.why: Roar of the Slayer is 800 range against Parrrley's 625 and can destroy a keg before it arms, so Sion owns all three opening rows; Gangplank's real rows are level 6 and the Sheen item; a full-tank Sion takes the last row back.
audit.corrected: Both charts set to Sion/Sion/Sion/Skill/Gangplank/Gangplank/Sion, and the matchup re-rated TRICKY at 7/10 to match a 47.84% win rate.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate and complete: Sion's level 1-3 E range, Gangplank's level-6 Cannon Barrage zone on an immobile target, the Sheen burst window, and Sion's Unstoppable Onslaught dive threat. Four entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer is built entirely on Decimating Smash and states 'Charged = knockup' without saying that a partial charge does NOT knock up — so the reader treats every swing as lethal and gives up free trades. Roar of the Slayer, which is the ability that actually loses Gangplank the early lane, is never named in the full layer, nor is its armour shred. Soul Furnace and Unstoppable Onslaught are absent too.
audit.why: Riot text, Decimating Smash (Q): 'If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned' — 10/9/8/7/6. Roar of the Slayer (E): 800 range, 12/11/10/9/8, 'damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit', and knocks a struck minion back through you. Soul Furnace (W) shields on 15/14/13/12/11 and deals magic damage on reactivation after 3 seconds. Unstoppable Onslaught (R) is 140/100/60 with a terrain flag.
audit.corrected: Roar of the Slayer named with its 800 range and 12s cooldown; the full-charge condition on Decimating Smash stated; Soul Furnace's shield-then-reactivate timing implied through the 'don't dump into a fresh shield' don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the full layer despite five sequencing cues being counted in the packet.
audit.why: Roar of the Slayer 12s, Decimating Smash 10s, Unstoppable Onslaught 140s at rank 1 — the R cooldown especially is what makes an early dive answerable.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three flagged interactions appear nowhere: Sion sustains through chip with Glory in Death so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades; Soul Furnace and Glory in Death both scale on the target's maximum health, so stacking raw resistances is the wrong answer; and Unstoppable Onslaught creates terrain that cuts a dash-less Gangplank's retreat.
audit.why: Riot text: Glory in Death (P) — 'His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.' Soul Furnace (W) carries the same percent-health flag. Unstoppable Onslaught (R) carries the terrain flag and Gangplank has no dash in his kit.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal reason written into breakdown.late, the percent-health point into dontsFull[1].d, and the terrain/Flash point into phases[6].why.
